news.title: Vancouver’s language school sector faces a new reality
news.summary_en: EC English and ILAC's shock closures last month lay bare the challenges that have blighted Vancouver's language school sector for years, writes Patricio Alfaro.
news.author: Patricio Alfaro

news.title: US associations sue over ICE changes to international student internships
news.summary_en: Four major US higher education associations have launched a legal challenge against the federal government over changes to rules governing internships and practical learning for international students.
news.author: Kim Martin

news.title: Trump targets $70m in international education funding as opposition grows
news.summary_en: University groups are urging Congress to reverse the cuts, while seven states have challenged the administration’s wider effort to withhold funding approved by lawmakers.
news.author: Abhishek Nair

news.title: BSC Education enters liquidation, ceases trading
news.summary_en: The English language school group with centres in the UK, Malta is entering liquidation.
news.author: Kim Martin

news.title: Trump administration proposes $70,000 OPT fee
news.summary_en: The Trump administration has proposed charging US universities $70,000 for each international student they recommend for Optional Practical Training (OPT), with institutions facing further annual fees for extensions.
news.author: Kim Martin

news.title: Russell Group universities to showcase UK higher ed at China open days
news.summary_en: Fifteen UK research-intensive universities will take part in collaborative events in Shanghai and Beijing designed to highlight future skills, academic excellence and the long-term value of a UK education.
news.author: The PIE News team

news.title: CU Denver takes step towards India campus in Hyderabad
news.summary_en: The university plans to begin teaching in August 2027, with admissions awaiting final UGC approval and its initial location and cohort size still being determined.
news.author: Abhishek Nair

news.title: UWA gets green light for Chennai as two-campus India bet takes shape
news.summary_en: The Group of Eight university will begin classes in Chennai on October 19, completing the initial launch of an AUD $80m India expansion spanning two cities.
news.author: Abhishek Nair

news.title: Australia’s Coalition pledges to scrap Temporary Graduate visas, cut student numbers
news.summary_en: If elected, the Coalition has vowed to abolish Temporary Graduate visas and cut international student commencements to 240,000 a year under a sweeping migration plan.
news.author: Kim Martin

news.title: Mainland students fuel Hong Kong’s education boom
news.summary_en: More than half of Hong Kong’s higher education students are now from outside the territory, according to research from BONARD Education and the British Council research, as the city accelerates efforts to strengthen its position as a regional education hub.
news.author: Kim Martin

news.title: In focus: How UK unis are staying under the 5% BCA threshold
news.summary_en: As institutions scramble to stay compliant under tightened BCA requirements, Spencer Withrington uncovers one of the ways universities are staying under the new 5% visa refusal threshold – and the cost it is having on students.
news.author: Spencer Withrington

news.title: Inside South Korea’s push to bring IB into mainstream schools
news.summary_en: Wilson Shang explores how South Korea has emerged as one of the world’s most prominent testbeds for embedding international curricula into mainstream state schooling.
news.author: Wilson Shang
